mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (login_id, password, name, company_id, role) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{companyId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT u.*, c.company_name as companyName, c.company_type as companyType FROM user u JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT u.*, c.company_name as companyName, c.company_type as companyType FROM user u JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT u.*, c.company_name as companyName, c.company_type as companyType FROM user u JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id ORDER BY u.user_id DESC
SELECT u.*, c.company_name as companyName, c.company_type as companyType FROM user u JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_type = 1 ORDER BY u.name ASC
SELECT u.*, c.company_name as companyName, c.company_type as companyType FROM user u JOIN company c ON u.company_id = c.company_id WHERE u.status = 0 ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
